Definition: from G2596 and G5087; to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively):--do, lay, shew.
BiblicalUsage: Felix left Paul bound, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, and Festus asked if Paul would go up to Jerusalem to be judged there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul was left in chains by men who wanted favour, and the chains were the price of his innocence.
RelatedEvents: Paul Before Felix, Festus, and Agrippa
